pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

3. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)
   A. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Saum has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.
   D. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Purity of Actions? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hadith on Purity of Actions has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Zakat: has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Zakat: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat:.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

11. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.
   C. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   B. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Saum and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Hajj and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues: Ibadah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. A — Telling the truth and keeping trust

3. B — Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. B — Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. B — Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. B — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. D — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

11. C — Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. D — Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Saum; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hajj; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Virtues: Ibadah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Virtues; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
